title: Ambient exchange counit, shift compatibility and full-subcategory restriction
statement:
Fix the standing separated finite-type scheme setting [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting] and any commutative condensed ring $R$. Let $p:X\to Y$, $g:Y'\to Y$, $g':X'\to X$, $p':X'\to Y'$ form a commutative square; it need not be cartesian. On ordinary unbounded derived module-object categories write $P_u=Lu^*$, $G_u=Ru_*$ with canonical adjunctions and counits $\varepsilon_u$, and let $\theta:P_{p'}P_g\cong P_{g'}P_p$ be the canonical pullback comparison. Define the ambient map
$$B:P_gG_p\longrightarrow G_{p'}P_{g'}$$
by the unit of $P_{p'}\dashv G_{p'}$, then $G_{p'}\theta$, then $G_{p'}P_{g'}\varepsilon_p$. For every $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}_{R_X})$, in right-to-left functional notation its components satisfy
$$\varepsilon_{p',P_{g'}K}\circ P_{p'}(B_K)=P_{g'}(\varepsilon_{p,K})\circ\theta_{G_pK}.$$
The two ambient functors are exact and $B$ commutes with their canonical integer-shift comparisons, hence induces morphisms of distinguished triangles including the connecting square. If the four pullbacks and two pushforwards in this formula preserve chosen full triangulated subcategories, and the restricted adjunctions/composition maps are their restrictions, then the restricted $B$ is exactly the unit--square--counit map of [det-def-sfb-base-change-morphism-bc], with the same components. In particular this applies to $\Dbc$ whenever these are full triangulated subcategories and the stated preservation and restriction hypotheses hold.

proof.text: Expand the general full-subcategory mate into its unit, square-comparison image and counit image. ObjectProperty.liftFullSubcategoryAdjunction_unit_app_hom and its counit counterpart identify the restricted adjunction components with the ambient ones. The lift acts on morphisms by the original functor map, and the square-component hypothesis identifies the middle component, giving the ambient exchange. For the actual bounded-constructible map [det-def-sfb-base-change-morphism-bc, sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible], first identify its three-step natural transformation with Adjunction.squareExchange using squareExchange_eq_unit_square_counit [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-square-exchange]. Its squareExchange_map_counit equation gives the restricted counit equation. Apply the inclusion to this equation. Adjunction.map_restrictFullyFaithful_counit_app identifies the underlying restricted counits, and the restricted pullback maps by the ambient pullback. The stated square-component hypothesis and the proved object equations therefore identify this with the ambient counit equation from step 4. Injectivity of the inverse ambient adjunction hom equivalence proves equality of components. A proved private helper keeps both transformations and square comparisons as parameters while carrying out this calculation; explicitly reducing only the small full-subcategory lift, inclusion and functor composition definitions normalizes hidden object arguments before the final comparison. No restricted data construction is changed. The triangulated-subcategory hypotheses retain the inherited structures [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory].
